The phone display shows 3 Brews items including Molten Cake (﷼24), Tiramisu Cake (﷼24), Kunafa (﷼35), and Iced Latte (﷼15), plus a minimum order of ﷼15 and a 35–50 minute delivery time.
analysis.visual_summary: A burgundy 3Brews delivery announcement graphic shows hands using a phone with a 3Brews delivery menu, alongside coffee drinks and desserts including a tiramisu-style cake and chocolate dessert. HungerStation, Keeta, and Jahez logos are prominent, with 3Brews branding on the image and drink cups.
analysis.caption_summary: Arabic caption announces that 3Brews coffee and desserts can now be ordered through HungerStation, Keeta, and Jahez, emphasizing fast home delivery and asking followers which platform they will order from.

evidence.text: "اطلب من 3Brews الآن عبر: HungerStation، Keeta، Jahez" and "أي منصة بتطلب منها اليوم؟" explicitly invite ordering through the listed platforms and invite a response.
The graphic states "We are now on HungerStation, Keeta & Jahez" and displays the three delivery-platform logos with a 3Brews ordering screen and doorstep-delivery message.
Coffee and dessert images surround a phone menu displaying named 3Brews items and Saudi-riyal prices; 3Brews logos appear on the graphic, phone listing, and cups.
The supplied raw content type is Image in the feed.

warnings: Reel/video visual analysis uses supplied cover/images plus transcript when available; full raw video frames are not analyzed.
